name: Sahel insurgency
value: Insurgency sustained; no capital newly fallen
summary: Armed men killed 37 civilians near Téra in western Niger on 12 Nov; insurgency sustained; no capital newly fallen
state: Armed men killed at least 37 civilians, including women, in an ambush on villagers travelling to Téra market in Niger's Tillabéri region on 12 Nov, according to agency reports carried by DH/Belga and Euronews Arabic. JNIM and Islamic State Sahel Province continue to fight state forces and each other across the Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger border zone. Searches on 23 Nov found no fall or blockade of a capital or major city and no mass-casualty attack in a coastal state, so Watch holds.
for_you: FCDO advises against all travel to most of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger. Coastal states' northern border areas carry elevated risk; check FCDO travel advice before visiting.
rubric_hit: Sustained insurgency at current levels = Watch; no capital blockade or coastal-state mass-casualty attack
